title: Crash-prompt toggle persists to PreferencesStore but boot reads DevicePreferencesStore — choice may not survive relaunch

description: Discovered during Wave 1d (out of its scope, filed by orchestrator). CrashReportingSection (iOS DebugPage) and CrashReportingPane (macOS) bind PreferencesStore.Prefs.crashPromptsEnabled (the Core-Data-backed field) for the Settings toggle and persist via PreferencesStore.update, while AppEnvironment.crashPromptsEnabled (what CrashReporterHost actually reads at boot) initializes from DevicePreferencesStore. The toggle's .onChange only mirrors into the in-memory environment.crashPromptsEnabled and never persists to DevicePreferencesStore, so the user's crash-prompt choice may not survive relaunch. Fix belongs with the preferences-partition wiring; assigned to plan 6a residual sweep. Reproduce first: toggle the setting, relaunch, observe boot value.
